_README: Rows whose sentence-length options are byte-identical to English ON PURPOSE.
docs/QUIZ-RETRANSLATION.md: 'Do not fix those; forcing them into Tagalog makes the deck worse.'
The heuristic in quiz_xlate_rules.py already excludes proper nouns (capitalisation) and
number lists (digit ratio). It cannot see the classes below, so they are listed by hand,
each with the reason a reviewer accepted it. An id may only be added after looking at the
options — this file is the audit trail, not a mute-button.
Anything NOT listed here still fails check-quiz-translation.py, which is the point.
